Interesting ketiv/qere cases in NAEE

Features of interest · NAEE book links · Dataset documentation

Ketiv is the primary text, with pointed qere above it at the same size. When qere is wider, the shorter ketiv is centered beneath it. Use the verse reference to open this copy of NAEE, or “Published” to open the website. The verse includes surrounding text and notes.

  1. 2 Samuel 8:3 — a wide qere
  2. Isaiah 54:16 — a wider single-atom qere
  3. Genesis 30:11 — two qere atoms
  4. Qere without ketiv

2 Samuel 8:3 — a wide qere

The qere is a maqaf compound above a shorter ketiv atom. Look at the space reserved for the pair in the verse.

Genesis 30:11 — two qere atoms

Qere without ketiv

Ruth 3:5 and Judges 20:13 show qere without ketiv. NAEE puts the editorial label “no ketiv” on the baseline. That label occupies space beneath the qere.
